findings.finding: The unit test instructions asked for a test that captures logs and asserts no token, code, email, amount or request key appears. None was written. The "never write tokens or personal details into logs" rule (NFR10.10) rests only on a one-time search showing no print, debugPrint or log calls in lib. I repeated that search and it is clean today, but nothing stops a later change from adding a log call.
findings.required_action: Add a small guard test or a CI grep step that fails if lib gains print, debugPrint or developer.log calls. Otherwise record at the gate that NFR10.10 is accepted as unverified by a test.

findings.required_action: Keep these as open checks before release. Do not treat the 5/5 fake-backed journeys as proof of the real sign-in, API and data path.

findings.required_action: The person decides at the gate whether to keep, change or remove both marks.

findings.required_action: Treat the sensor output as a known false positive. Do not rework the traceability file for it.
